answer: The Design mockup signed off by a domain expert backed by a reputation bond ties standing to delivered value: the design mockup is reviewed line by line, the reputation bond is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so an identity is earned by doing something useful, not by filling in a form. Like a plume in a workshop, one odd piece hides easily, so the check runs on every submission rather than a sample. The delta test catches the lazy fake and the ember test catches the patient one.
